description: Defines Flutter widget classes 'LabeledField' and 'MaskedCardNumber' used for form input fields and card number display, respectively.

classes.name: LabeledField
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a label above a styled input container, with customizable size and styling features.

classes.name: MaskedCardNumber
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that visually represents a masked card number with last four digits displayed prominently, and includes accessibility semantics.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the respective widget, constructing styled text and containers.
